backgroundParagraphs: Hey, I'm Antonis Skandalis, and I've been building web applications for 10 years. I'm based in Paros, Greece, and work with clients locally and remotely. What keeps me engaged is the challenge of creating interfaces that feel intuitive and perform well under real-world conditions.

I've worked at startups and bigger companies, and I care a lot about writing clean code and building things that scale. I mostly use React and TypeScript, but I'm happy to jump into the full stack when it's needed. If you need a website, web app, or custom software — get in touch.
When I'm not shipping features, you'll find me tinkering with new tech, crafting a new idea, traveling to new places or just playing piano.
